package.description: Terminal-based filesystem reconnaissance tool (size-aware directory tree)

en-US.description: Terminal-based filesystem reconnaissance tool (size-aware directory tree)
en-US.longDescription:
Tachikoma is a terminal-based filesystem reconnaissance tool that renders an
interactive, size-aware directory tree. It highlights space hogs at a glance
with per-directory totals, color-coded sizes, and fast recursive scanning of
large trees.
en-US.name: tachikoma
